column1: # The tier 1 text-fit scan at Segoe UI 9 pt, 100%: every new overflow, new overlap or parent-edge pass of a control that sizes itself, and bounds difference,
# sorted by the file's rank in fit-scan-files.tsv. kind: overflow = a control whose text no longer fits (need_width, need_height: pixels missing); selfsizing-* = a control that
# sizes itself grows into a neighbour (before and after: its bounds); bounds-* = the bounds differ from today's font. verdict: fixable (free space) or needs the owner.
